core: Regulation of drug and cellular stress responses
name: Regulation of drug and cellular stress responses including apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate responses to drugs, antibiotics, oxidative, osmotic and hypoxic stress, and unlike the ethanol/anesthetic and respiration confusables they include stress-linked apoptosis and mitochondrial depolarization.

name: Chaperone-mediated protein folding including CCT/TriC tubulin folding
rationale: All members concern chaperone-assisted folding and assembly, centred on prefoldin-CCT/TriC folding of tubulin and actin, without the telomerase/Cajal body or tubulin modification content of the confusables.

qualifier: L1-ankyrin nodal sodium channel clustering and dendrite self-avoidance
name: Neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion, L1-ankyrin nodal clustering and self-avoidance
rationale: Members are neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion molecules (L1, CHL1, NrCAM, neurofascin, DSCAM, SDK, nectins) and their roles in nodal/paranodal sodium channel clustering and dendrite self-avoidance, unlike the myelination, RPTP or axon-repulsion confusables.

qualifier: SOS and MRAS-SHOC2 driven RAF activation
name: Ras-to-RAF activation via SOS and MRAS-SHOC2
rationale: Members cover Ras activation and its relay to RAF, MEK and RSK, distinguished by SOS signalling and MRAS-SHOC2 RAF activation rather than the ERK feedback inactivation or RAS GAP content of the confusables.

name: Rho activation by G alpha 12/13 receptors and Sema4D-plexin-B
rationale: All members drive Rho activation, via G12/13-coupled receptors and Sema4D-plexin-B/RND1 signalling, whereas the confusables are Sema3A axon repulsion and other Rho-family GTPase cycles.

core: Suppression of effector T cell responses
name: Suppression of effector T cell responses and Treg induction
rationale: Members negatively regulate T cell activation, proliferation, Th1/Th17 commitment, IL-2 and IFN-gamma while promoting Treg differentiation, unlike confusables centred on dendritic cell costimulation, Th1 promotion or tolerance/anergy.

core: Skeletal muscle differentiation and neuromuscular junction
name: Myofibre differentiation and postsynaptic neuromuscular junction assembly
rationale: Members combine myogenesis with postsynaptic NMJ assembly (proteoglycans, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, AChR clustering), unlike confusables on presynaptic cholinergic transmission, basement membrane or diaphragm development.

qualifier: excision, mismatch, translesion and direct reversal
name: Excision, mismatch, translesion and direct-reversal DNA repair
rationale: Members cover base and nucleotide excision repair, mismatch repair, translesion synthesis, alkylation reversal and associated repair synthesis, whereas the confusables centre on double-strand break repair and recombination.

qualifier: pyrimidine/deoxynucleotide breakdown and NUDT pool sanitisation
name: Pyrimidine and deoxynucleotide catabolism with NUDT pool sanitisation
rationale: Members degrade pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotides and hydrolyse nucleoside triphosphates (NUDT, thiopurine handling), unlike confusables on nucleotide biosynthesis, salvage or purine deoxynucleoside metabolism.

name: Vocal learning, auditory and mechanosensory behaviour
rationale: Members concern vocal and observational learning with auditory and mechanosensory behaviour and striatal development, unlike confusables on motor, social or mating behaviour and hindbrain development.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 lipid presentation
name: MHC-II and CD1 antigen presentation by myeloid cells
rationale: Members are MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation and dendritic cell/monocyte signatures including NKT regulation, unlike the MHC class I cross-presentation confusable.

name: Iron and heme uptake, transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members centre on transferrin, ferroportin, DMT1, ceruloplasmin and heme scavenging, distinguishing them from copper/manganese, oxygen transport and scavenger receptor confusables.

name: Mitochondrial tRNA processing, modification and import
rationale: Members process, modify and import tRNAs in mitochondria, unlike confusables on mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA and ribosome assembly or nuclear tRNA processing.

name: Exploratory and locomotor behaviour with glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission
rationale: Members combine locomotor, exploratory and sensorimotor-gating behaviours with positive regulation of glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission, which the behaviour-only confusables lack.

name: UCH- and USP-family deubiquitination regulating protein stability
rationale: Members concern UCH/USP deubiquitinases and regulation of proteolysis and protein stability, unlike confusables on ubiquitin chain types, aggrephagy, proteasome or ERAD.

core: ER membrane protein targeting and insertion
name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII ER-to-Golgi export
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent, tail-anchored and multi-pass insertion into the ER and COPII cargo export, unlike confusables on ER quality control, ERAD and COPI retrograde traffic.

name: Epithelial adherens junctions, cadherin adhesion and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members concern cadherin-based adherens junctions, epithelial apical-basal polarity and EMT restraint, unlike desmosome/hemidesmosome, CDH1 turnover or endothelial confusables.

name: GPI anchor biosynthesis from UDP-GlcNAc and protein attachment
rationale: Members synthesise the GPI anchor and its UDP-GlcNAc precursor and attach it to proteins, unlike confusables on N-glycosylation, dolichol and sialic acid metabolism.

name: LXR-driven cholesterol efflux, HDL formation and sterol homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, HDL formation and foam-cell suppression under LXR control, unlike confusables on SREBP biosynthesis, oxLDL uptake or lipoprotein remodelling.

name: Vascular smooth muscle cell differentiation and vessel remodelling
rationale: Members concern VSMC development, differentiation and dedifferentiation with vessel remodelling, unlike endothelial confusables or those on VSMC migration, proliferation and apoptosis.

name: Dopamine synthesis and DAT-mediated reuptake
rationale: Members cover dopamine biosynthesis, catecholamine metabolism and SLC6A3 reuptake, unlike confusables on dopamine receptor signalling or norepinephrine transport.

name: Host control of viral and retroelement transcription and latency
rationale: Members concern host activation or suppression of viral transcription, HCMV latency and KRAB-ZFP/HUSH silencing of retroelements, unlike confusables on the HIV replication cycle.

name: PTEN regulation by ceRNAs, stability and localization
rationale: Members regulate PTEN through competing endogenous RNAs, stability and localization and its loss in cancer, unlike confusables on downstream AKT and PI3K signalling.

name: TLR7/8/9-IRF7/IRF5 signalling driving type I interferon production
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling to IRF7/IRF5 and IFN-alpha/beta production, distinguished from confusables on TLR trafficking, TLR3 deficiency and cGAS/STING.

name: APC/C-mediated ubiquitination controlling anaphase and mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern APC/C-Cdc20/Cdh1 regulation, Emi1 control and K11 ubiquitination driving anaphase and mitotic exit, unlike confusables on cohesion, spindle, PLK1 or G1/S transcription.
